propositions: Cross-subtree blocking links silently escalate to nearest common ancestor endpoints without notifying library or MCP callers that a different edge was recorded
The redirect record is printed to stdout via _emit_redirect but never returned, so callers using quiet=True or non-CLI interfaces receive only 'ok' with no indication of substitution
add_dependency, link_core, _link closure, _python_leaf, and rebar.link() must each return the redirect record through the call chain; three layers currently drop it
The MCP link_tickets tool must return a formatted string indicating both the requested and recorded endpoints when escalation occurs, while returning exactly 'ok' for unescalated links
_python_leaf is shared by all Tier B leaf writes and must be widened to return values rather than None, while quiet=True sink must remain intact to protect MCP stdio protocol
